jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, OpenTelemetry | Ireland | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Ireland.

About Product Management:
As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.

Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.

Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes. You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers. This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

Your scope will include:

  • OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
  • Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
  • Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
  • Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
  • Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
  • Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
  • Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
  • Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
  • The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution

Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.

This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.

AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.

The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
  • Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
  • Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
  • Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
  • Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
  • Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation
  • Extend beyond product delivery to how the OpenTelemetry experience is positioned and brought to market. In partnership with Product Marketing and go-to-market teams, you’ll help define the product narrative, sharpen out differentiation, and develop launches, technical content, adoption programs, and campaigns that create demand and accelerate customer activation.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams to deliver and communicate a differentiated OpenTelemetry experience
  • Represent Grafana Labs and its customers in relevant OpenTelemetry ecosystem discussions

What makes you a great fit:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong track record in developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data platforms, or another technically complex B2B product domain
  • Experience leading strategy and execution across multiple engineering teams or product areas without relying on direct organizational authority
  • Strong working knowledge of OpenTelemetry, including SDK instrumentation, OTLP, Collector pipelines, telemetry context, and semantic conventions
  • Experience using or building instrumentation systems, agents, telemetry collectors, configuration products, or related infrastructure
  • An understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and operating software across Kubernetes, virtual machines, and public cloud environments
  • Experience turning complex onboarding, configuration, and troubleshooting workflows into clear and approachable product experiences
  • A history of using customer research and product data to make decisions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points:

  • Experience contributing to or building products around the OpenTelemetry or broader open source observability ecosystem
  • Experience with automatic instrumentation, eBPF, or runtime-based instrumentation
  • Firsthand experience as an SRE, platform engineer, developer, or observability practitioner
  • Experience building product-led onboarding, configuration-validation, or telemetry-health experiences at scale

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 133,600 - EUR 160,320. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Minimum Requirements

  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation.For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role
We are looking for a person who joins the Collection Team and will support us in our daily tasks. A Collection Specialist Level 3 is responsible for managing and improving the collections process to recover outstanding debts while maintaining positive customer relationships. It is a senior level position responsible for managing the most challenging and high-value accounts within a collection. They work closely with customers to resolve outstanding payment issues and may have the authority to handle complex negotiations, settlements, payment plans, referring delinquent accounts to collections agencies and legal aid, when necessary, while providing expertise and guidance to junior collectors. This role often involves more extensive data analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, be detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

Customer Interaction:

Communicate with customers through various channels, including phone, email, and written correspondence, regarding complex issues, addressing concerns, resolving disputes, and negotiating payment arrangements.

Provide excellent customer service while dealing with customers, answering their questions, and addressing concerns professionally and courteously.

Account Management:

Handle the most complex and high-value delinquent accounts, making decisions regarding the best approach to maximize recovery.

Monitor, track, and document all communications, agreements, and payment activities. Communicate with internal stakeholders, such as sales and customer service teams, to resolve customer issues and ensure timely payment.

Negotiation:

Negotiate with customers to reach mutually acceptable solutions, which may involve offering settlements, discounts, or extended payment terms.

Documentation:

Maintain detailed and accurate records of all collection’s activities, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

Escalation:

Provide regular updates on collection activities and account status to management.

Determine when to escalate delinquent accounts to a higher level of collections or recommend legal actions, as necessary. Identify and escalate high-risk accounts to management for further action.

Data Analysis:

Analyze customer accounts to identify trends and payment behaviors, making data-driven decisions to improve collection strategies.

Reporting:

Generate and analyze collection reports to assess the effectiveness of collection efforts.

Provide insights for process improvement.

Provide regular updates to management.

Compliance:

Ensure all collection activities adhere to relevant laws and regulations governing collections activities, such as the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA).

Training and Support:

Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to junior collection staff (Level 1 and 2), offering expertise on complex cases and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

Qualifications:

To excel in this role, an individual must successfully execute each crucial task. The outlined requirements below are indicative of the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities. Appropriate accommodations may be provided to empower individuals with disabilities to fulfill essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

At least 3 years of relevant experience in collections (must)

FluentEnglish and French language min. B2/C1 (must)

MS Office fluency (Word, Excel)

In-depth knowledge of relevant laws and regulations governing collections activities.

Familiarity with basic accounting principles

Proficiency in using collection software and Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and data analysis tools.

Experience with collections software or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is a plus.

Required Skills and Abilities:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.

Attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

Ability to work well under pressure, meet deadlines and make sound judgements. Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast-paced environment.

Willingness to learn and follow established procedures.

Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Able to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally, in writing, and by electronic communications with both internal and external clients.

Excellent customer service skills.

Ability to lead, coach and mentor and individual or team.

Multi-lingual is preferred.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required to sit for extended periods of time.

Required to wear a telephone headset to interact with clients and/or associates over the phone.

Required to type for extended periods of time.

Required to work with digital displays.

Director, Corporate Communications

AI's ambitions keep outpacing the infrastructure and economics underneath it. WEKA exists to close that gap. The WEKA® NeuralMesh™ software platform gives enterprises, AI cloud providers, research teams, and frontier AI builders a unified foundation for AI training, inference, and agentic workloads, purpose-built for the inference economy.

A growth-stage company backed by world-class investors, WEKA holds more than 170 patents and is trusted by the world's most ambitious AI builders and innovators. We're accountable, brave, collaborative, and customer-centric. These core values define how we work and win together. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

WEKA is seeking a Director, Corporate Communications, to lead and scale our internal and external communications function, including earned media, employee communications, employer brand, and issues management. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you'll set the public relations agenda, direct our agency of record, keep employees informed and inspired, and turn WEKA's story into coverage, conversation, and credibility.

You'll drive a communications program that already has real momentum in thought leadership and trend authority. Your mandate is to build on that foundation and raise the bar, helping cement the company's position as a category leader. You’ll be joining an AI-forward team that uses AI across research, monitoring, drafting, and measurement, with human judgment and storytelling as the differentiator. You'll set that standard.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll shape communications strategy and execute it yourself: writing press releases, running launch-day logistics, editing your team's work, and building programs from the ground up. Leaders who thrive at WEKA lead by doing.

What You'll Be Working On

Public Relations

  • PR strategy and signature moments. Own the earned media agenda end to end: product launches, corporate announcements, and the campaigns between them. Decide what's a story, what's a stunt, and what's a pass.
  • Media and influencer coverage and relationships. Build a durable pipeline of tier-one tech, business, and AI trade coverage. Cultivate relationships with journalists, podcasters, and independent influencers who are shaping coverage of AI infrastructure, including those traditional PR playbooks miss.
  • Narrative amplification. Bring WEKA's corporate narrative to life across earned and owned channels, translating approved messaging into stories the media wants to tell and ensuring every pitch, placement, and headline reinforces WEKA's category position.
  • Spokesperson and subject matter expert development. Grow WEKA's bench of technical spokespeople through bylines, panels, and speaking programs, in close partnership with the VP of Corporate Marketing.
  • Issues and crisis communications. Own the playbook for the moments nobody plans for: pre-staged materials, clear escalation paths, calm hands, and coordinated messaging inside and out.

Internal Communications and Employer Brand

  • Employee communications. Keep everyone at WEKA informed, connected, engaged, and excited about where WEKA is going, with programs that reach both remote and in-office teams equally. Manage company-wide channels and oversee content for all hands and town halls.
  • Employer brand. Develop campaigns and materials that strengthen WEKA's reputation as a place to do career-defining work, in partnership with our People team, and measure employee sentiment and engagement along the way.
  • Change communications. Help leadership communicate wins, changes, and challenges with authenticity and consistency during periods of growth and transition.

Leadership and Operations

  • Team and agency leadership. Manage, develop, and scale a global Corporate Communications team. Direct WEKA’s global PR agency expansion, strategy, and output; set clear expectations, drive high performance, measure what's working and calibrate what’s not.
  • Operational excellence. Build the operating system for a high-demand function: intake workflows, service-level agreements, templates, and prioritization frameworks that manage inbound requests from across the company, set clear expectations with stakeholders, and protect the team's capacity for the work that matters most.
  • AI-forward communications operations. Modernize how the function works: AI-assisted monitoring and rapid response, measurement that connects coverage to how LLMs and search engines find and describe WEKA, and workflows that multiply the team's impact. Partner with Digital Marketing on generative engine visibility.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in corporate communications, with a background spanning both external and internal communications and 3+ years leading teams and agencies.
  • B2B tech depth, ideally in AI, cloud, or data infrastructure; you can hold your own in a conversation about GPUs, AI inference, and why memory architectures matter, and you know when to bring an SME.
  • A player-coach leadership style: you still pitch, write, and edit alongside your team, and you're energized by doing the work, not just directing it.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency in your practice: you use AI tools daily, you have a point of view on where they accelerate communications work and where they fall short, and you can teach that judgment to a team.
  • Proven track record building media relationships and running PR campaigns with measurable outcomes. Examples of writing, media, and executive visibility placements are required.
  • Familiarity with generative engine optimization and how earned media influences LLM authority and shapes AI-generated answers and citations.
  • Crisis and change communications experience under real pressure.
  • Sharp editorial judgment and a low tolerance for vendor-speak; if a message could have come from any storage company, you strike it.
  • Proven success building within global growth-stage companies in competitive, fast-moving technology categories.

Good to Have

  • Experience navigating a category transition or corporate repositioning.
  • A combination of agency and in-house experience preferred.

How We Work: Core Company Values

  • We're Accountable: We take full ownership, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard.
  • We're Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. Challenges and debate are fuel for growth.
  • We're Collaborative: We lift each other up to succeed collectively. We communicate with empathy and challenge each other respectfully. We are transparent about our goals and results. Together, we're unstoppable.
  • We're Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We listen to their needs and prioritize their success. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned you don't meet all the qualifications? Don't let that stop you from applying.

WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. Studies show that underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply if they don't meet every qualification, but if you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—you may be the right fit for this or other opportunities. WEKA is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination or harassment of any kind, providing fair opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of background or protected status.

jobs.title: Remote Clinical Validation Reviewer ( Coding RN)
jobs.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTION Job SummaryProvides support for inpatient and outpatient clinical claim review activities.
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides support for inpatient and outpatient clinical claim review activities. Verifies that coded diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, and corresponding reimbursement methodologies accurately reflect the member's documented clinical condition, services rendered, and billed charges. Assesses medical records for clinical accuracy, acuity alignment, and documentation integrity. Identifies inconsistencies that impact reimbursement such as unsupported diagnoses, incorrect procedure coding, or inaccurate revenue code assignment and determines whether billed services meet coding and billing guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements. Contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.

Essential Job Duties

  • Reviews inpatient and/or outpatient claims to ensure diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, itemized charges, and Diagnostic Related Groups (DRG) assignments accurately reflect the documented clinical condition and services provided.
    • Integrates ICD‑10 coding principles, DRG methodologies, revenue code logic, and evidence‑based clinical guidelines when reviewing claims for accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with documentation.
    • Performs DRG validation reviews by verifying principal and secondary diagnoses, complications/comorbidities, procedure coding, severity level, and correct grouping logic.
    • Conducts itemized bill reviews to confirm that charges are supported by clinical documentation, compliant with billing standards, and appropriate for the level of care delivered; identifies unsupported, inaccurate, or inappropriate coding or billing elements such as unsubstantiated diagnoses, incorrect procedures, or incorrect revenue code usage.
    • Develops clear, evidence‑based written rationales supporting diagnosis, procedure, revenue code, or DRG recommendations and determinations.
    • Substantiates all review outcomes using clinical indicators, documentation, coding guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements.
    • Performs review work independently, applying sound clinical judgment and specialized expertise to evaluate complex claim scenarios.
    • Applies applicable federal/state regulations, official coding guidelines, payer policies, and Molina payment integrity standards during all reviews.
    • Ensures compliance with DRG and itemized bill review criteria, clinical validation rules, and reimbursement methodologies.
    • Collaborates with coding, payment integrity analytics, SIU, and physician advisors to clarify complex clinical documentation, coding discrepancies, or reimbursement determinations.
    • Provides subject matter expertise on DRG validation, revenue code accuracy, itemized bill review, and documentation integrity to internal partners as needed.
    • Meets or exceeds established productivity goals set by payment integrity leadership for clinical validation and claim review activities.
    • Achieves the required accuracy and quality standards for review, diagnosis/procedure validation, and/or itemized bill reviews.
    • Participates in quality checks, calibration sessions, and ongoing training to maintain consistency and strengthen review competency.
    • Completes special projects and additional review assignments as delegated by leadership. Identifies patterns and trends in documentation, coding, or billing that may require internal escalation, provider education, or process improvement.
    • Supports continuous improvement efforts by contributing insights that enhance review processes, criteria application, and workflow efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in inpatient payment integrity medical claim review including DRG validation or itemized bill review, and experience working with ICD-10, MS-DRG, AP-DRG and APR-DRG, CPT, HCPCS, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Registered Nurse (RN). License must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.

• Advanced in DRG methodologies.

  • Expertise in UHDDS definitions, official inpatient coding guidelines, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid (CMS) and Medicaid state guidelines for billing and coding, and AHA’s coding clinic guidelines.
    • Expertise in evidence-based clinical decision support tools and clinical reference resources such as UpToDate, Merck Manual or similar.
    • In-depth knowledge of clinical criteria and documentation requirements to support code assignments.
    • Proven ability to apply critical judgment in clinical and coding determinations.
    • Experience working within applicable state, federal, and third-party regulations. Analytic, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    • Organizational and time-management skills and attention to detail.
    • Critical-thinking and active listening skills.
    • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software program(s) proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Clinical Documentation Improvement Practitioner (CDIP), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or other advanced HIM/coding certifications. Nursing experience in critical care, emergency medicine, medical/surgical, or pediatrics (including high‑acuity areas such as ICU, ED, PICU, or NICU).

📍 Ort: Remote - Germany

Über uns

Die Harris Computer Germany GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Harris Computer Gruppe, einem Unternehmen der Constellation Software Inc. Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Branchensoftware wachsen wir kontinuierlich – sowohl organisch als auch durch Unternehmensakquisitionen.

Die Harris International Group sucht dich als erfahrenen Portfolio Manager:in, um gemeinsam mit dem DACH Portfolio Leader das weitere Wachstum des Portfolios durch strategische Akquisitionen voranzutreiben. Dabei verantwortest du den gesamten Transaktionsprozess – von der Identifizierung potenzieller neuer Akquisitionsziele bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss der Transaktionen.

In deiner Rolle als Portfolio Manager:in berichtest du an den DACH Portfolio Leader und verantwortest die Suche, Identifizierung und Bewertung potenzieller Akquisitionsziele, den Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen sowie deren Weiterentwicklung bis zum erfolgreichen Transaktionsabschluss. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Softwareunternehmen in den Bereichen öffentlicher Sektor, Sicherheitswesen, Gesundheitswesen und Versorgungswirtschaft in der DACH-Region.

Die Position umfasst den gesamten Transaktionszyklus, einschließlich des Aufbaus nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Zielunternehmen, der proaktiven Identifizierung neuer Opportunitäten, der Finanzmodellierung, der Due Diligence, des Transaktionsmanagements und der Entwicklung passender Transaktionsstrukturen.

Du bist von Natur aus neugierig, denkst unternehmerisch und begeisterst dich für Investitionen und die Weiterentwicklung von Unternehmen. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte finanzielle und analytische Fähigkeiten mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in Geschäftsentwicklung, Beziehungsmanagement und operativer Führung. Erfahrung in mindestens einem der Bereiche öffentlicher Sektor, Sicherheitswesen, Gesundheitswesen oder Versorgungswirtschaft ist unerlässlich. Deine Transaktionserfahrung ergänzt du idealerweise durch Erfahrung in der operativen Führung und im Management von Softwareunternehmen.

Diese Remote-Position kannst du von deinem Wohnsitz innerhalb Deutschlands aus ausüben. Die Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen ist erforderlich

KI- und Innovationsorientierung

Wir setzen gezielt auf neue Technologien, um unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und nachhaltige Geschäftsergebnisse zu erzielen. Dabei verstehen wir KI nicht nur als technologische Unterstützung, sondern als festen Bestandteil einer modernen und effizienten Arbeitsweise.

Diese Offenheit für Innovation bringst auch du mit: KI-gestützte Tools nutzt du gezielt, um Arbeitsabläufe zu optimieren, Analysen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und neue Lösungswege zu finden. Dabei gehst du verantwortungsvoll mit neuen Technologien um und behältst die Anforderungen an Sicherheit, Vertraulichkeit und Compliance stets im Blick.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Transaktionszyklus - von der Identifizierung und Qualifizierung neuer Chancen über die Verhandlung und Weiterentwicklung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss von Transaktionen.

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Corporate-Development-Team identifizierst und bewertest du potenzieller Akquisitionsziele.

  • Neue Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten identifizierst du proaktiv, vereinbarst qualifizierte Gesprächstermine und entwickelst potenzielle Zielunternehmen entlang der M&A-Pipeline weiter – vom Erstkontakt bis zur Unterzeichnung der Transaktion.

  • Der Aufbau und die Pflege langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu bestehenden und potenziellen Akquisitionszielen gehören zu deinen zentralen Aufgaben – durch persönliche Treffen, Telefongespräche und E-Mail-Kommunikation.

  • Aktivitäten, Chancen und relevante Informationen dokumentierst du sorgfältig und genau in Salesforce (CRM).

  • Relevante Konferenzen und Branchenveranstaltungen identifizierst und besuchst du gezielt. Darüber hinaus organisierst du Roadshows, um Leads zu generieren und Beziehungen zu potenziellen Zielunternehmen zu stärken.

  • Gemeinsam mit dem M&A-Team begleitest du Finanzmodellierung, Due Diligence und Verhandlungen und steuerst den Prozess souverän bis zum erfolgreichen Transaktionsabschluss.

  • Fundierte Investmentthesen entwickelst du auf Basis deiner Analysen und präsentierst deine Empfehlungen vor dem Investment Committee.

  • Gegenüber potenziellen Akquisitionszielen vermittelst du die Investmentphilosophie, Strategie und das Wertversprechen von Harris klar und überzeugend.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass jeder Akquisitionsprozess professionell und effizient gesteuert wird und der Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen stets im Mittelpunkt steht.

  • Regelmäßige Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands und der DACH-Region sowie zunehmend innerhalb Europas gehören je nach Bedarf zu deiner Rolle.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen M&A, Financial Due Diligence, Corporate Development, Business Development, Investment Management, Finanzen, General Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung oder Unterstützung von M&A-Transaktionen verbindest du mit einem echten Interesse an den Unternehmen über die eigentliche Transaktion hinaus.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der operativen Führung mit, beispielsweise als General Manager oder in einer leitenden Managementfunktion in einem operativen (Software-)Unternehmen. Perspektivisch kannst du auch mit der Führung von Unternehmen in Deutschland, der DACH-Region und – mit unserem weiteren Wachstum – in ganz Europa betraut werden.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Finanzmodellierung, Analyse und kaufmännischer Bewertung zeichnen dich aus.

  • In der Geschäftsentwicklung bringst du nachgewiesene Kompetenzen mit, einschließlich Leadgenerierung, Qualifizierung von Geschäftschancen und Beziehungsaufbau.

  • Erfahrung in der Softwarebranche, insbesondere in den Bereichen öffentlicher Sektor, Sicherheitswesen, Gesundheitswesen oder Versorgungswirtschaft, ist für diese Position erforderlich.

  • Der Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen gehört zu deinen Stärken. Mit Führungskräften auf C-Level sowie Unternehmenseigentümer kommunizierst du souverän und wirkungsvoll. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf persönliche Beziehungen, die du durch regelmäßige persönliche Treffen und nicht ausschließlich durch Remote-Gespräche und E-Mails aufbaust.

  • Du überzeugst mit ausgezeichneten mündlichen und schriftlichen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

  • Hervorragende Organisations- und Priorisierungsfähigkeiten helfen dir dabei, mehrere Akquisitionsprozesse und Projekte gleichzeitig zu steuern.

  • Eine proaktive, eigenmotivierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.

  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich.

  • Die erforderliche Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit zu regelmäßigen Reisen bringst du mit.

Über Harris

Harris ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter geschäftskritischer Software- und Servicelösungen. Als hundertprozentige Tochtergesellschaft von Constellation Software Inc. ("CSI") bildet Harris einen Eckpfeiler der Investitionen von CSI in den öffentlichen Sektor, das Gesundheitswesen, die Versorgungswirtschaft und den privaten Sektor. Unser Erfolg basiert auf Investitionen in unsere proprietäre Software und unsere Marktkompetenz. Dieser Fokus hat zusammen mit dem Erwerb von Unternehmen, die unser Angebot erweitern oder ergänzen, maßgeblich zu unserem Erfolg beigetragen. Harris wird auch künftig durch Reinvestitionen wachsen - sowohl in unsere Mitarbeitenden und Produkte als auch durch Investitionen in den Erwerb weiterer Unternehmen.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und remote work

  • 30 Tage Urlaub (zusätzlich frei am 24. und 31.12., sowie zu besonderen Anlässen)

  • Verschiedene Weiterbildung und Entwicklungsprogramme

  • Finanzielle Leistungen (u.a. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen)

  • Neben diversen Mitarbeiterrabatten bekommst du monatlich einen steuerfreien Sachbezug von 50€ über Probonio – flexibel einsetzbar für Einkäufe, Tanken oder deine Freizeit.

  • Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung (u.a. Programm zur Förderung der Mentalen Gesundheit und Bike Leasing)

  • Förderung einer positiven Arbeitsumgebung und -kultur

Wir suchen Talente, die mit Leidenschaft bei der Sache sind und den Willen haben, sich weiterzuentwickeln. Niemand ist perfekt, daher erwarten wir nicht, dass du alle Anforderungen zu 100% erfüllst. Wenn du dich mit Engagement einbringen kannst, zögere nicht, dich bei uns zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Harris legt großen Wert auf Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben fest daran, dass Vielfalt und Integration entscheidend für unseren Erfolg sind. Deshalb unterstützen und fördern wir ausnahmslos alle Bewerbende sowie Mitarbeitende gleichermaßen.

jobs.excerpt: Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide.
jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Manager, Customer Service leads high-volume call center operations that directly influence customer trust, service quality, order accuracy, and retention. This role is primarily responsible for leading the day-to-day performance of customer service supervisors and frontline agents, ensuring teams consistently meet service, quality, productivity, and customer experience expectations.

The Senior Manager serves as a hands-on operational leader who develops supervisors, strengthens frontline performance, manages escalations, improves workflows, and builds a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement. This role requires deep call center leadership experience, strong people-management skills, sound operational judgment, and the ability to translate performance data into clear actions.

The ideal candidate is an experienced call center leader who knows how to manage through supervisors, build high-performing teams, improve execution, and maintain stability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, or another regulated industry is beneficial but not required. The primary need is a proven call center expert who can lead people, improve performance, and raise operational standards.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

People and Team Leadership

  • Team Leadership: Lead the daily performance of customer service supervisors and frontline agents across high-volume service channels. Establish clear expectations, maintain strong communication, and ensure teams consistently deliver accurate, timely, and professional service.
  • Supervisor Development: Coach and develop supervisors to become stronger people leaders. Build their capabilities in performance management, employee coaching, accountability, engagement, communication, conflict resolution, and operational decision-making.
  • Performance Management: Set clear individual and team expectations and ensure consistent follow-through. Monitor performance, identify gaps, provide timely feedback, recognize strong performance, and implement corrective action when expectations are not met.
  • Employee Development: Create an environment of continuous learning and development. Identify high-potential employees, support succession planning, and establish development plans that prepare supervisors and agents for increased responsibility.
  • Employee Engagement: Promote a positive, accountable, and service-oriented culture. Maintain visibility with the team, encourage open communication, address employee concerns, and partner with Human Resources to support engagement and retention.

Call Center Operations

  • Operational Leadership: Oversee daily call center execution, including service levels, productivity, attendance, schedule adherence, quality, customer satisfaction, and escalation management. Ensure supervisors are actively managing performance throughout the day.
  • Workforce Execution: Partner with workforce management and operational leaders to align staffing, scheduling, and intraday decisions with customer demand. Proactively respond to volume changes, staffing shortages, service disruptions, and evolving business priorities.
  • Performance Monitoring: Use operational dashboards, call center reports, quality results, and customer feedback to identify performance trends and areas requiring action. Translate data into practical coaching, staffing, and process decisions.
  • Service Consistency: Ensure policies, procedures, communication standards, and customer-handling expectations are applied consistently across supervisors, teams, shifts, and service channels.
  • Operational Stability: Maintain control of daily operations by anticipating risks, addressing issues early, and ensuring leaders are prepared to respond to changing customer demand and business needs.

Customer Experience and Escalation Management

  • Customer Experience: Ensure customer interactions are handled with accuracy, urgency, empathy, and professionalism. Reinforce behaviors that reduce customer effort and build trust.
  • Escalation Resolution: Oversee complex or high-impact customer escalations that require leadership attention or cross-functional coordination. Ensure escalations are resolved promptly, documented appropriately, and used as learning opportunities.
  • Customer Advocacy: Review customer feedback, complaints, quality findings, and service trends to identify recurring issues. Advocate for improvements that strengthen the customer experience and reduce preventable contacts.
  • Quality Oversight: Partner with quality leaders to ensure customer interactions meet organizational, regulatory, and service expectations. Use quality results to improve coaching, reduce performance variability, and reinforce consistent standards.

Continuous Improvement

  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies, recurring customer issues, and operational barriers that affect employees or customers. Lead improvements that simplify work, reduce errors, strengthen consistency, and improve team performance.
  • Standard Work: Establish and reinforce clear operating routines, leadership expectations, escalation processes, communication practices, and performance-management standards.
  • Change Leadership: Lead supervisors and agents through process, policy, system, and organizational changes. Ensure leaders understand the change, communicate it effectively, reinforce expectations, and monitor adoption.
  • Technology Adoption: Support the effective adoption of approved call center technologies, automation, reporting, and AI-enabled tools. Reinforce proper use, provide operational feedback, and ensure teams maintain appropriate human judgment, accountability, privacy, and compliance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Operational Partnership: Partner with Pharmacy Operations, Quality, Compliance, Workforce Management, Information Technology, Human Resources, Training, and other departments to resolve customer and operational issues.
  • Communication: Communicate operational performance, risks, staffing concerns, customer trends, and improvement opportunities clearly to leadership and key business partners.
  • Business Execution: Translate organizational priorities into clear expectations and measurable actions for supervisors and frontline teams. Ensure leaders understand how daily execution supports broader customer service and company objectives.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Regulatory and Policy Compliance: Ensure customer service teams follow applicable policies, procedures, privacy requirements, documentation standards, and regulatory expectations.
  • Operational Controls: Maintain effective controls related to customer interactions, escalation handling, documentation, system access, and employee performance.
  • Risk Identification: Identify potential customer, employee, compliance, or operational risks and escalate concerns through the appropriate channels. Partner with subject-matter experts to implement corrective actions.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated expertise leading customer service operations using workforce management, performance analytics, AI-enabled technologies, KPI development, forecasting methodologies, and continuous improvement principles to improve service quality, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
  • Proven ability to build, coach, and develop supervisors into effective people leaders while fostering accountability, engagement, and high-performance team cultures.
  • Strong experience with performance management, coaching, employee accountability, corrective action, succession planning, and leadership development.
  • Demonstrated success improving customer service metrics, including service levels, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, and operational efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of contact center operations, including service-level management, workforce planning, schedule adherence, quality assurance, escalations, capacity planning, and intraday performance management.
  • Ability to interpret call center reporting, operational dashboards, workforce analytics, and quality metrics to make informed business decisions and drive continuous improvement.
  • Strong leadership capabilities with exceptional communication, executive presentation, coaching, change management, stakeholder influence, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills within fast-paced, rapidly evolving business environments.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, evaluate risks, prioritize initiatives, and make informed decisions that balance customer experience, compliance, productivity, and financial performance.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, workforce management systems, business intelligence tools, quality-monitoring applications, reporting tools, Microsoft Office 365, and emerging AI technologies that enhance decision-making, automation, knowledge management, and operational execution.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant leadership experience.
  • Minimum of eight years of progressive call center or contact center leadership experience, including responsibility for high-volume customer service operations.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing supervisors, team leads, and frontline customer service employees while developing leadership capability and driving team performance.
  • Experience leading teams through operational growth, organizational change, technology implementations, or large-scale process improvements.
  • Experience supporting customers across multiple service channels, including phone, email, chat, and case management.
  • Experience with contact center technologies, CRM platforms, workforce management systems, quality-monitoring applications, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, pharmaceutical services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple supervisors, teams, business functions, shifts, or locations preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Job Description:

The Provider Data Representative maintains accurate provider demographic, participation, credentialing, enrollment, roster, and directory information across all systems supporting the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP).

The role ensures provider data integrity to support accurate claims payment, credentialing compliance, provider directory accuracy, and network participation. The Representative partners with Provider Relations, Credentialing, Provider Data, Claims Operations, and Contracting to keep provider information complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with organizational standards.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Directory accuracy & completeness: Meet internal standards and regulatory expectations; reduce member/provider complaints due to directory errors.

  • Maintenance timeliness: Process updates, additions, terminations, and changes within SLAs; reduce cycle time and backlog.

  • Data integrity: Improve audit scores; lower claims‑impacting data error rates; maintain accurate NPIs, TINs, specialties, practice locations, affiliations, licenses, and EFT details.

  • Roster reconciliation effectiveness: Validate rosters against credentialing, enrollment, terms & conditions, claims, and directory data; correct discrepancies promptly.

  • Credentialing & enrollment support: Ensure data readiness for onboarding and recredentialing; reduce participation activation delays.

  • Operational reporting: Provide clear dashboards and logs for productivity, turnaround times, accuracy, and issue remediation.

Data Intake & Maintenance Operations

  • Process provider roster submissions and updates.

  • Maintain accurate provider demographic, enrollment, and participation records.

  • Validate and update NPIs, TINs, specialties, practice locations, EFT details, and affiliations.

  • Ensure timely changes supporting accurate claims payment and directory publication.

Roster Reconciliation

  • Reconcile provider rosters against credentialing, claims, enrollment, and directory systems.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Work alongside our fire, hospital and EMS Engineering teams to secure our mission-critical applications. These applications are used to help our customers go about their daily job of protecting their communities and saving lives.

You’ll lead our team of Security Engineers, supporting and directing our Product & Technology team to ensure our products and systems are designed and implemented with a priority on security. You’ll collaborate closely with our Product & Technology teams, contributing to application architecture and steering system implementation. Your teams work will draw on principles like defence in depth and leverage practices such as threat modelling and zero trust across a multi-cloud environment - with focus on best practice, security by design and implementation of standards and frameworks across our portfolio.

Our Security Engineers have a high degree of autonomy, and are part of a high functioning, motivated and forward-thinking team. You have the chance to join a diverse, growing and passionate team, working on critical products, whilst being supported with training opportunities and mentoring.

This is a remote position, with candidates required to be based in Canada

Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship; candidates must have full authorization to work in Canada

What You’ll Be Doing – the day to day

  • Lead our team of Security Engineers – assisting with decision making and solution analysis, and enabling them to deliver security consulting to the wider business
  • Work directly with, and provide escalated support and guidance to, our Product & Technology teams to assist in how our platform is built and how our applications behave; supporting everything from the security of our users inside our products to how our applications connect to the Internet.
  • Have significant impact on the security of our systems that are used by thousands of fire fighters, paramedics and hospitals worldwide.
  • Be a key part of our cyber security team, with demonstrable impact on the security of our systems and applications. 
  • Help our teams to model threats using the STRIDE model, against new designs, ensuring appropriate protection and controls are in place.
  • Make a difference by mitigating vulnerabilities across our systems, helping developers to produce secure code and evaluating new next-gen security technologies.
  • Respond to security and compliance issues generated via analysis or automated tools.
  • Work collaboratively cross-team, to impart your expertise across the organisation.
  • Be in the detail, working shoulder-to-shoulder with our technology teams.

Who You Are - some of the essential things required to be successful in the role

  • At least 5 years’ experience in securing software or infrastructure in cloud platforms (e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Your experience should include;
  • Securing systems in line with ‘Well Architected Frameworks’ e.g. Azure Well Architected Framework
  • Network experience – whether designing and building, managing or troubleshooting – you should have experience and confidence in your networking knowledge
  • Applying security to networks, hosts, web applications and cloud native deployments
  • Working with toolsets from one or more of: asset management, vulnerability management, firewalls, SIEM, PAM, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, DLP, SWG, WAF, CSPM, CNAPP
  • A solid understanding and ideally experience in the design, implementation or run of one or more of: SAST / DAST / IAST / RASP

You should also:

  • Having knowledge of Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment best practices, and securing pipelines
  • Understand current attack tactics, techniques and procedures along with the use of MITRE Attack framework and associated MITRE security research
  • Be inquisitive, have a passion for what you do and understanding how your work impacts and contributes ESO’s success

Who You Are – it’s desirable if you have any of the following

  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code and Azure native technologies
  • Experience with threat modelling, NIST and CIS frameworks
  • Knowledge of application security standards such as OWASP Top 10, SANS / CWE 25

- Peace of mind benefits such as life insurance and disability insurance

jobs.excerpt: AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today.
jobs.description:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.

Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!

The Company:

Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.

What’s in it for you:

Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.

Address:

Guatemala

The Senior Technical Product Owner is a senior team member responsible for translating business product strategy into executable technical deliverables and ensuring development teams deliver maximum business value. Working with the business Product Manager who owns overall product strategy, the Senior TPO manages complex product backlogs, drives tactical execution, and mentors junior TPOs. Holds acceptance authority for completed work and creates precise, AI-ready requirements using Given-When-Then (Gherkin) format. Models AI-augmented engineering excellence — integrating AI capabilities where appropriate, evaluating outputs rigorously, and shaping team practices for prompt design, evaluation, and safety.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

AI-Augmented Engineering Excellence

  • Model AI-augmented engineering excellence — design solutions that integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, RAG, agents) where appropriate.
  • Demonstrate active AI fluency — use AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as a daily co-engineer for code generation, test creation, documentation, and learning.
  • Write AI-ready requirements (Given-When-Then/Gherkin) that enable AI-assisted development tools to generate accurate, testable code.
  • Evaluate AI outputs rigorously and shape team practices for prompt design, evaluation, and safety.
  • Stay current with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and equivalents) and evangelize best practices across the team.

Story Creation & Requirements Engineering

  • Author comprehensive user stories using Given-When-Then format with complete behavioral context (Given = initial state/preconditions, When = actions/triggers, Then = expected outcomes).
  • Define explicit acceptance criteria covering happy paths, edge cases, error conditions, and complex integration scenarios.
  • Include technical constraints, validation rules, business logic, performance requirements, security considerations, and compliance standards.
  • Provide concrete examples with sample data, API specifications, and reference implementations.
  • Document dependencies, integration points, and system interactions clearly for both human developers and AI-assisted tools.
  • Collaborate with technical product managers, architects, and technical leads on architectural context and design patterns.
  • Handle complex, enterprise-level requirements involving multiple systems and cross-functional dependencies.

Story Acceptance & Quality Leadership

  • Review and accept completed stories, validating functionality meets all acceptance criteria and enterprise quality standards.
  • Test delivered functionality against each Given-When-Then scenario across multiple integration points.
  • Verify solutions handle all documented scenarios including edge cases, security requirements, and performance benchmarks.
  • Exercise final acceptance authority, ensuring deliverables are production-ready before release.
  • Coordinate with QA teams on acceptance criteria alignment and automated testing strategies.
  • Provide structured feedback for stories requiring remediation.

Backlog Management & Prioritization

  • Own and maintain complex user story backlogs, strategically prioritizing based on business value, technical dependencies, and risk.
  • Translate business product strategy and roadmap into detailed, development-ready user stories.
  • Break down complex features into appropriately sized stories while maintaining technical coherence.
  • Make tactical trade-off decisions to maximize value delivery within constraints.
  • Sequence backlog items accounting for dependencies, risk mitigation, technical debt reduction, and incremental delivery through creation of release plans.
  • Manage backlog across multiple teams or complex product areas when required.
  • Identify and escalate strategic risks or impediments impacting delivery.

Team Leadership & Agile Excellence

  • Lead sprint ceremonies including planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Partner with Scrum Masters, developers, architects, QA engineers, and designers to drive team efficiency.
  • Provide real-time expert guidance on business logic and acceptance criteria during development.
  • Present completed work during sprint reviews, demonstrating acceptance and articulating business value.
  • Foster collaborative environment encouraging questions and continuous improvement.
  • Champion Agile and BDD practices across the organization.

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

  • Serve as senior point of contact between development teams and business stakeholders.
  • Facilitate complex requirements discovery sessions with diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure business readiness.
  • Communicate sprint progress, release readiness, and risks to business Product Manager, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Negotiate scope, priorities, and trade-offs balancing business needs with technical realities.
  • Influence technical execution through data-driven insights from delivery and user feedback.

Mentorship & Organizational Impact

  • Mentor and coach junior TPOs (Associate TPO, TPO) on GWT story writing, requirements craft, acceptance practices, and quality standards.
  • Review stories created by junior team members ensuring quality and consistency.
  • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and training of new product ownership team members.
  • Participate in or lead communities of practice for product owners.
  • Drive adoption of new tools, methodologies, or practices improving delivery effectiveness.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 7–10 years as a TPO, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Owner in Agile teams.
  • Minimum 3–5 years at senior/lead level handling complex, enterprise-scale products.
  • Expert in writing detailed user stories with comprehensive acceptance criteria using Given-When-Then format.
  • Strong Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) experience.
  • Advanced technical acumen with system architecture, data models, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Proven leadership within Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Expert proficiency with Agile tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence).
  • Outstanding communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members.

Preferred

  • CSPO, A-CSPO, CPO, or PMI-ACP certification.
  • Experience with BDD tools (Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.).
  • Understanding of test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Background in software development, architecture, or QA.
  • Experience leading product ownership for multiple teams.

EZCORP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

  • Develop and support SAP integration services that enable the secure and reliable exchange of data between SAP ECC and connected enterprise applications

  • Work with business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants and technical team members to deliver integration solutions that meet business requirements.

  • Monitor, troubleshoot and resolve integration incidents, interface failures and data processing issues in line with customer SLAs.

  • Support integration services across development, test and production environments, ensuring reliability, performance and operational stability.

  • Participate in solution design, deployments, releases and change activities within an ITIL-managed services framework.

  • Maintain integration documentation, technical standards and support procedures.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, platform stability and operational efficiency.

What We’re Looking For:

Essential Skills

  • 3+ years’ experience supporting SAP integrations within SAP ECC 6 environments.

  • Experience with SAP integration technologies including IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs and web services.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for resolving interface, data and production support issues.

  • Experience working within a Managed Services environment using ITIL processes and delivering against customer SLAs.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  • Exposure to production releases, change management and continuous service improvement practices.

  • Strong documentation and quality assurance practices, including technical specifications, unit testing, transport management and adherence to development standards.

  • Experience with webMethods integrated systems.

  • Basic ABAP debugging and SAP technical and network troubleshooting skills.

Desirable

  • Experience with webMethods integrated systems.

  • Basic ABAP debugging and SAP technical and network troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience within Energy, Utilities or other asset-intensive industries.

Why Join Us:

  • Deliver tangible business impact through operational excellence.

  • Work with cutting-edge tools and AI-enabled platforms.

  • Be part of a high-performing, client-obsessed team that values growth and innovation.

Take the next step with us. Apply now and make a real impact.

Your skills. Our impact. Together unstoppable. At NRI, you’ll work on meaningful projects, tackle complex challenges, and see the tangible difference your expertise makes. We value diverse experiences and perspectives, creating an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing workplace. Don’t worry if you don’t meet every requirement listed - we prioritise attitude and capability, and you might be the perfect fit for this role or another within NRI.

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
