jobs.excerpt: Job Description:Job Title: Director of Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management Reporting Structure: Chief Financial Officer Department: Finance and Accounting Job Purpose:The Director of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Compliance provides enterprise-level leadership, governance oversight, coordination, and strategic guidance for the System’s risk and compliance framework.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Director of Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management
Reporting Structure: Chief Financial Officer

Department: Finance and Accounting

Job Purpose:

The Director of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Compliance provides enterprise-level leadership, governance oversight, coordination, and strategic guidance for the System’s risk and compliance framework. The position develops and maintains the System-wide Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program, methodologies, governance processes, and reporting practices that support informed decision-making, organizational resilience, and Board oversight.

The Director serves as a strategic advisor to executive leadership by monitoring the evolving regulatory and risk landscape facilitating enterprise risk assessments, providing executive level reporting and analysis, and promoting consistent risk management practices across the System.

Operational responsibility for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and managing risks remains with the institutional leadership and functional executives. The Director provides the governance framework, enterprise coordination, and executive visibility necessary to support consistent risk management while respecting institutional authority and accountability.

Role Impact:

The Director strengthens the System by promoting a consistent enterprise approach to risk management that aligns decentralized institutional risk management practices with System-wide strategy, governance expectations, regulatory compliance, and Board oversight. Through enterprise coordination, executive advisory services, and strategic reporting, the Director enhances operational resilience, supports informed decision making, and reinforces clear accountability for risk ownership across the System.

Key Position responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Enterprise Risk Oversight

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the System-wide ERM framework, methodologies, tools, and reporting standards.
  • Guide institutions in conducting risk assessments and maintaining institutional risk registers using consistent enterprise methodologies.
  • Aggregate and analyze institutional risk information to develop and maintain the System’s enterprise risk profile.
  • Identify and elevate cross-cutting, systemic, and emerging risks requiring executive leadership or Board consideration.
  • Facilitate the development and periodic review of the System’s risk appetite and risk tolerance in partnership with executive leadership and the Board.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise risk escalation protocols for material or emerging risks.
  • Lead the System Risk and Compliance Committee and other cross-functional governance committees.
  • Develop enterprise dashboards, key risk indicators (KRIs), and executive reports that support governance and strategic decision making.

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Monitor the evolving federal, state, accreditation, and industry regulatory landscape affecting higher education.
  • Partner with executive leaders and functional subject matter experts to evaluate enterprise impacts of significant regulatory developments.
  • Provide executive leadership and institutional leaders with strategic regulatory briefings, trend analyses, and enterprise impact assessments.
  • Facilitate cross-functional coordination related to significant regulatory changes and emerging compliance risks.
  • Conduct proactive regulatory horizon scanning to support strategic planning and organizational preparedness.
  • Promote consistent enterprise communication regarding significant regulatory developments.

Board Engagement

  • Prepare and present risk reports, dashboards, and emerging risk updates for executive leadership and Board committees.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board regarding enterprise risks, regulatory developments, governance trends, and leading practices.
  • Support the Board’s enterprise risk governance responsibilities through education, strategic reporting, and periodic review of the System’s enterprise risk profile.

Risk Framework & Control Alignment

  • Establish and maintain enterprise risk assessment methodologies, documentation standards, and risk reporting practices.
  • Collaborate with Internal Audit, Legal Affairs, Compliance, and other functional leaders to provide enterprise risk insights that inform risk-based audit planning and compliance monitoring while maintaining the independence of assurance functions.
  • Facilitate periodic enterprise risk reviews to evaluate aggregate risk exposure, organizational resilience, and mitigation effectiveness.
  • Monitor trends in significant audit, compliance, and risk findings to identify recurring systemic issues and opportunities to strengthen governance and internal controls.
  • Develop and monitor enterprise key risk indicators (KRIs) and other metrics that measure changes in the System’s risk profile.

Culture & Capacity Building

  • Provide strategic guidance and consultation to institutions in advancing Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) maturity.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise methodologies, tools, guidance, and educational resources that promote consistent risk management practices and compliance awareness.
  • Foster a culture of risk awareness, ethical decision making, and shared accountability throughout the System.
  • Promote the integration of enterprise risk management into strategic planning and executive decision making.

Risk Domain Scope

The Director provides enterprise-level coordination, governance oversight, and reporting across the System’s major risk domains. Functional executives and institutional leaderships retain responsibility for identifying, managing, and mitigating risks within their respective areas of authority. Major risk domains include, but are not limited to:

  • Financial sustainability and liquidity (Chief Financial Officer)
  • Enrollment, admissions, and revenue concentration (Enrollment and Marketing)
  • Title IV compliance and federal regulatory compliance (Student Financial Affairs and Legal Affairs)
  • Accreditation, licensure, and state authorization (Academic Affairs and Institutional Leadership)
  • Information security, cybersecurity, data privacy, and technology resilience risk (Information Technology)
  • Reputational and strategic communications (Executive Leadership and Marketing/Communications)
  • Business continuity, emergency management, and crisis response (Executive Leadership)
  • Third-party, vendor, and strategic partner risk (Functional leadership in collaboration with Finance, Procurement, and Legal Affairs)

Crisis Management & Business Continuity

  • Support executive leadership through enterprise crisis governance, cross-functional coordination, and post-incident reviews.
  • Coordinate enterprise risk assessments with institutional business continuity, disaster recovery, and organizational resilience planning.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise incident reporting and risk escalation protocols.
  • Facilitate post-incident lessons learned reviews to identify systemic issues and strengthen enterprise resilience.

Performance Indicators

  • The Enterprise Risk Management program demonstrates measurable improvement in organizational maturity, consistency, and effectiveness.
  • Executive leadership and the Board receive meaningful, timely risk intelligence that supports governance and strategic decision making.
  • Enterprise risks are proactively identified, escalated, and monitored through established governance processes.
  • Institutional risk management practices demonstrate increasing consistency with System-wide ERM methodologies and reporting standards.
  • Recurring systemic risk themes identified through enterprise risk assessments, audits, and compliance monitoring decrease over time through strengthened governance and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Enterprise risk management is effectively integrated into strategic planning, governance, and major organizational initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledge of higher education governance, accreditation, regulatory compliance, and federal financial aid requirements.
  • Demonstrated success advising executive leadership and presenting complex risk and governance matters to senior leadership and Board committees.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and build consensus in matrixed organizations where success depends on collaboration rather than direct authority.
  • Familiarity with recognized ERM frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM or ISO 31000).

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Higher Education Administration, Public Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CRM, CIA, CCEP, CISA, CRISC, or PMP) preferred.

Experience:

  • Seven (7) to ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise risk management, compliance, governance, internal audit, or related disciplines, including leadership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and advancing ERM frameworks within complex, decentralized, or multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide initiatives involving organizational change, governance transformation, or strategic business process improvement.

Compensation & Benefits

This opportunity is budgeted at $140,000 - 150,000 base compensation. Additional compensation factors may impact total compensation. To learn more about our competitive benefits and additional rewards, including generous paid time-off, medical and dental insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, multiple flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, click the link below.

The artificial intelligence tool is a resource only and all employment decisions are made by staff members.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Performance Creative Strategy
jobs.excerpt: The job in one lineYou run the team that makes our video ads.
jobs.description:
The job in one line

You run the team that makes our video ads.

Not the brand film. Not the packaging. The hundreds of pieces of video that go into paid social every month, get measured against hook rate and CPA, and either scale or die.

Creative is our single biggest growth lever. Right now it's the constraint. We're hiring the person who removes it.

What you'll actually do

Build and run the creative engine. Hire and lead a pod of creative strategists and performance editors. Set the concept volume, the testing cadence, and the standard. Own the pipeline from insight → brief → shoot/edit → launch → read → iterate. You are accountable for throughput and for what the work does to blended CAC.

Decide what we make and why. Translate performance data and customer research into creative frameworks — angles, hooks, formats, and segmented lanes across our product line. You should be able to look at a week of results and say what to make next, and defend it.

Own the creative testing system. Structured hypotheses, clean reads, real learning loops. We want a library of what works and why, not a folder of ads. You'll partner closely with growth on measurement and with our data team on the numbers behind it.

Direct creator and UGC output. Write the briefs. Set the formats. Make sure what comes back from creators is built to perform, not just built to look nice. Own content acquisition strategy end to end.

Set the visual and tonal guardrails. Energy, pacing, tone, what feels undeniably Everyday Dose — and what converts without eroding trust. We are not chasing trends. We're defining a lane.

Work across the company. Product on launches and positioning. Retail on adaptation. CX on mining what customers actually say. Growth on where the money goes.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • A functioning creative pod with a clear operating cadence
  • A step change in concept volume and iteration velocity
  • Improved blended CAC attributable to creative, not just to spend
  • A documented point of view on what works for our customer, backed by tests
  • A team that thinks in hypotheses, not in trends

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in performance creative and/or direct-response marketing, with real ownership of paid video
  • You have personally led a team producing video ads at volume — in-house or at a performance creative shop. If you've worked at or alongside a TubeScience-model operation, we want to talk.
  • DTC or CPG background. Supplements, wellness, beauty, or fitness is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in the numbers. Hook rate, thumbstop, hold, CVR, CPA, blended CAC, LTV. You can read a creative report without a translator.
  • Strong instincts for female-focused wellness brands and an understanding of the midlife female consumer
  • Taste, and the ability to explain it. You can articulate why something works, not just that it did.
  • You use AI tooling daily to move faster on ideation, iteration, and QA

Bonus

  • You've helped scale a nine-figure DTC brand
  • You've built and mentored a creative team while managing up to a demanding exec
  • Direct-response or VSL background

What this role is not

  • Not a brand-only storyteller
  • Not a pure art director
  • Not a production or post manager
  • Not a media buyer

If your portfolio is beautiful but you can't tell us what it did to CAC, this isn't the right fit — and that's fine.

How to apply

Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us:

  1. Three ads you made that worked — link or file. For each, one or two lines on the insight behind it and what it did to performance. Numbers if you have them; honest estimates if you don't.
  2. One ad you made that failed, and what you learned.
  3. A short answer: you're handed a wellness brand doing eight figures with a CAC that's crept up 30% in six months. Creative is stale. What are your first three moves, and in what order?

We read these carefully. Applications without them won't move forward.

Benefits

  • Strong base, performance bonus
  • Meaningful equity because we want you to own a piece of what you build
  • Health benefits + health stipend
  • Generous time off
  • Free product

Job Title

Senior Manager, Service Desk Operations

Job Description

Senior Manager, Service Desk Operations (U.S. Remote)

You will lead the Service Desk Operations for North America, responsible for overseeing Service Desk Managers, Major Incident Management, and the direction of Level 1 support within a unified, ITIL-aligned support operating model.

Your role:

  • Lead day-to-day technical direction for Level 1 support operations, triage quality, and queue discipline, including direct oversight and management of Service Desk Managers and Major Incident Managers.
  • Drive first-contact resolution through disciplined knowledge use, known issue handling, and structured troubleshooting, mentoring managers on best practices and accountability for results.
  • Coach, develop, and provide ongoing feedback to Service Desk Managers and frontline staff on call control, documentation quality, customer communication, and professional growth.
  • Review ticket patterns, reassignment trends, and handoff points to improve flow and reduce waste, holding Service Desk Managers accountable for continuous improvement within their teams.
  • Identify training gaps and work with Service Desk Managers to build or refine job aids, scripts, and knowledge articles for recurring issues, fostering a culture of learning and development.
  • Promote compliance with regulated support processes, documentation expectations, and audit-ready operating practices, overseeing the performance management and development of Service Desk Managers to maintain standards and drive excellence.
  • You must be able to work core business hours in a US time zone and provide leadership support during critical incidents or high-volume service events as needed

You're the right fit if:

  • You’ve acquired 7+ years of experience in enterprise technical support, service desk operations, or incident management, including substantial hands-on work in a complex ITSM environment
  • Your skills include a deep understanding of Level 1 support operations, triage methods, and service request or incident intake controls. Knowledge of PACS, DICOM, HL7, or clinical workflow support environments. ServiceNow Fundamentals or equivalent ITSM platform training is a plus.
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Medical, Science related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. jobs.description:
ABOUT NYMBUS

Nymbus ( is not just a leader in fintech; we are a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our modern core platform and cloud based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and the SVP, Product Management role is among the most consequential leadership roles in delivering that vision. This role owns the Digital Banking domain: the product surface that defines how end users and businesses interact with their financial institution through digital channels.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

We are a remote first company, with occasional travel required for team collaboration or client engagement.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The SVP, Product Management, Digital Banking role is the senior product leader responsible for the strategic direction, squad output, and commercial outcomes of the Digital Banking domain at Nymbus.

You lead multiple squads that build digital banking experiences — from retail and commercial account management to digital account opening, onboarding, self-service, and cross-channel consistency. You manage Builders directly, collaborate daily with Architects and Shippers assigned to your domain, and are accountable for everything your domain ships.

This is not a traditional product management role. You operate with four capabilities simultaneously: strategic product leadership, people leadership of Builders, domain subject matter expertise, and AI-first execution. You are expected to be a hands-on SME in digital banking systems — someone who has designed, built, or deeply operated digital banking platforms and can guide your teams through the complexity of real bank workflows.

You should be equally comfortable discussing market strategy with an executive team, walking through an application funnel with a client, diagnosing friction in an onboarding workflow, and working with product and engineering teams to determine what needs to change.

THE OPERATING MODEL

You operate within Nymbus' AI-native solution operating model:

  • SVP, Product Management, Digital Banking (This Role): Owns the domain's strategic direction, manages Builders, drives commercial outcomes, and ensures squad output meets quality and velocity standards. You are the most senior product voice in your domain.
  • Builders (Your Direct Reports): Own product intent, specification, and implementation within each squad. You hire, develop, and performance-manage Builders. You set their priorities, remove their blockers, and ensure they operate at the AI-first standard Nymbus requires.
  • Architects (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Architecture organization but collaborate with you daily. They own system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency within your domain. You coordinate with them on data models, API contracts, and platform integration.
  • Shippers (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Product Operations Spine but collaborate with you daily. They own delivery quality, release management, and operational readiness. You coordinate with them on acceptance criteria, deployment cadence, and production stability.

YOUR DOMAIN: DIGITAL BANKING

  • The Digital Banking domain encompasses the product surfaces through which end users and businesses interact with their financial institution digitally. Current and planned pods include:
  • Digital Base / Retail: Core retail digital banking experience — account management, transaction views, transfers, bill pay, alerts, profile management, and mobile-first UX patterns.
  • Digital Commercial: Commercial banking digital experience — multi-user access, entitlements, ACH/wire origination, account analysis, positive pay, and complex approval workflows.
  • Deposit Origination (shared with Origination domain): Digital account opening flows — consumer and business deposits, identity verification, KYC/CIP orchestration, funding, and stateful onboarding workflows.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Own the product roadmap for the Digital Banking domain
  • Define the vision for how Nymbus delivers digital banking experiences that differentiate community financial institutions
  • Prioritize squad work against business outcomes, client needs, and platform strategy
  • Represent the domain in executive planning, client conversations, and board-level updates
  • Drive commercial outcomes — your domain's output directly impacts revenue, client acquisition, and retention

People Leadership (Builder Management)

  • Hire, develop, and performance-manage all Builders in the Digital Banking domain
  • Set clear expectations for AI-first execution, specification quality, and delivery velocity
  • Coach Builders on domain expertise, product judgment, and technical decision-making
  • Build a team culture of high agency, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Ensure Builders operate at the Nymbus hiring bar and AI fluency standard

Domain Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the authoritative SME for digital banking within Nymbus
  • Design and reason about end-to-end digital account opening flows for consumer and business deposits
  • Orchestrate identity verification, KYC, CIP, and fraud checks across multiple third-party providers
  • Specify stateful onboarding workflows including retries, exceptions, and manual review paths
  • Ensure cross-channel consistency between digital, branch, and call-center servicing experiences
  • Define UX patterns that balance regulatory disclosure requirements with modern, low-friction user experiences
  • Understand core-to-digital integration patterns including event propagation, synchronization delays, and reconciliation strategies
  • Guide teams through the complexity of multi-tenant digital banking — where platform capabilities must be configurable per institution without per-client engineering

AI-First Execution

  • Model AI-first working practices for the domain — use Kiro, Claude, and spec-driven development personally
  • Set the standard for how Builders in your domain leverage AI tools
  • Ensure specifications, designs, and implementations take full advantage of AI-augmented workflows
  • Drive continuous improvement in pod velocity through AI-native methodology
  • Evaluate and adopt new AI tools and practices that accelerate domain output

Cross-Domain Coordination

  • Coordinate with other SVPs of Core and Origination Domains on shared surfaces and dependencies
  • Partner with the Architecture Spine on platform-wide patterns that affect Digital Banking
  • Collaborate with COEs (UX, QA, Security) on standards compliance and shared components
  • Align with the Applied AI Practice on AI-driven opportunities within digital banking

QUALIFICATIONS:

Non-negotiables:

  • Technical product management leadership experience
  • Banking processes and product experience required. Commercial and lending highly preferred.
  • Experience at product or Fintech organizations.

AI-First Mindset

  • Active, hands-on experience with AI-assisted product design and development workflows
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools for specification, iteration, and problem-solving
  • Willingness to model AI-first practices for the entire domain
  • Comfort operating in a spec-first, AI-native development methodology

Digital Banking Expertise (Required)

  • 8+ years in product, engineering, or technical leadership roles in digital banking or financial services
  • Deep hands-on experience with digital banking platforms — you have built, operated, or led teams building digital banking products
  • Expert-level understanding of digital account opening, onboarding orchestration, KYC/CIP/fraud workflows
  • Experience designing multi-channel banking experiences (mobile, web, branch, call center)
  • Understanding of core banking integration patterns — how digital layers consume and interact with core systems
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms serving multiple financial institutions
  • Knowledge of regulatory frameworks affecting digital banking (Reg E, Reg DD, BSA/AML, UDAAP)

Leadership & Management

  • Experience managing and developing product builders, engineers, or technical product managers
  • Track record of building high-performing teams that ship working software
  • Ability to operate at strategic and tactical levels simultaneously — roadmap one day, specification review the next
  • Experience making priority tradeoffs across competing demands with incomplete information
  • Comfort with direct accountability for commercial outcomes tied to product delivery

Technical Fluency

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, data modeling, and system architecture
  • Ability to engage deeply in technical design discussions with Architects
  • Experience with modern development workflows, CI/CD, and deployment practices
  • Understanding of front-end and back-end technology stacks for web and mobile

WHAT WE ARE EXPLICITLY NOT LOOKING FOR

  • Product managers who manage backlogs but do not lead teams or own outcomes
  • Leaders without genuine digital banking domain expertise
  • People who manage up but do not build down
  • Those who confuse process compliance with product leadership
  • Candidates who have managed teams but never personally designed or built systems
  • Leaders uncomfortable with direct accountability for commercial results

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS AT NYMBUS

The SVP, Product Management, Digital Banking owns the product surface that most directly shapes how people experience their financial institution. Every account opening, every balance check, every transfer, every bill payment flows through what your domain builds. You are not managing a feature team — you are leading the construction of the digital face of banking for community institutions across America.

This role sits at the center of transformation: the most consequential leadership position in the model, where product strategy, people leadership, domain expertise, and AI-first execution converge.

BENEFITS:Annual Cash Bonus and Equity Options commensurate with the role level and experience

100% Remote

401(k) plan

Insurance - Health, Dental and Vision

Paid Time Off

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS As an AI-first company, we embrace leveraging the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to the importance of finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools at our disposal today, including the use of AI Video Interview tools, we remain committed to the human touch and oversight throughout the process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the role is based- this role is currently based in the US. Not all locations are available for consideration. Locations will be considered on a case by case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

$165,000—$180,000 USD

jobs.excerpt: Start: ab sofort | Level: Mid - Senior | Location: Deutschland, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche) Künstliche Intelligenz verändert die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, Entscheidungen treffen und Prozesse automatisieren.
jobs.description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Mid - Senior | Location: Deutschland, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Künstliche Intelligenz verändert die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, Entscheidungen treffen und Prozesse automatisieren. Als AI Engineer (gn) bringst du AI dorthin, wo sie im Arbeitsalltag echten Mehrwert schafft: Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in konkrete, produktive AI-Lösungen – auf Basis unserer Tool-Landschaft und einer entstehenden unternehmensweiten KI-Plattform.

Du arbeitest hands-on mit unseren AI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise und n8n, baust Workflows und Use-Cases, entwickelst unsere AI-Tools weiter und hilfst dabei, neue Tools einzuführen, zu konsolidieren und sinnvoll zu governen. Dabei denkst du von der ersten Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung.

Aufgrund organisatorischer und regulatorischer Anforderungen ist für diese Position ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Anforderungen in AI-Lösungen übersetzen

    • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in konkrete, umsetzbare AI-Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Business, Security & Engineering zusammen.
    • Du übernimmst Use-Cases von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Betrieb – inklusive Umsetzung, Abstimmung, Dokumentation und Transparenz.
    • Du bringst KI / LLMs und Agenten in produktive Workflows und arbeitest mit am Aufbau einer zentralen AI-Infrastruktur/Plattform

    Mit unserer AI-Tool-Landschaft arbeiten und sie weiterentwickeln

    • Du arbeitest hands-on an unseren Enterprise-AI-Tools (Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise) und hilfst, sie weiterzuentwickeln und besser nutzbar zu machen.
    • Du baust und betreust Workflows und Automatisierungen in n8n und unterstützt Teams dabei, sie eigenständig zu nutzen.
    • Du evaluierst und führst neue AI-Tools ein, konsolidierst bestehende und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Security Standards und Governance (z. B. für n8n).
    • Du entwickelst konkrete AI-Anwendungsfälle – z. B. RAG-Anwendungen, Chat-Assistenten oder Agenten, die Fragen beantworten, Hinweise geben oder mit menschlicher Freigabe Aufgaben ausführen.
    • Du entwickelst Governance-Modelle, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte sowie technische Leitplanken für den Einsatz von AI im Unternehmen.

    Daten nutzbar machen & nsere KI-Plattform aufbauen

    • Du bindest strukturierte und unstrukturierte Datenquellen an, bereitest sie für AI auf und sorgst für gutes Retrieval (z. B. Embeddings, Vektor-Suche, Reranking).
    • Du entwickelst unsere entstehenden, unternehmensweiten KI-Plattform mit – von „Antworten“ über „Empfehlen“ bis „Handeln mit Freigabe“.
    • Du befähigst Fachbereiche, AI sicher und effektiv einzusetzen, und bist technischer Sparringspartner für Business und Engineering.
    • Du bewertest neue Integrationen, Connectoren und Plattformfunktionen hinsichtlich Risiken, Governance und technischer Umsetzbarkeit.

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Erfahrung darin, Business-Anforderungen in technische AI-Lösungen zu übersetzen – idealerweise mit projekthaftem oder beratungsnahem Hintergrund.
  • Erfahrung in der Integration von KI / ML, LLMs und Agentic AI in produktive Workflows.
  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools wie n8n (oder vergleichbar) und Freude daran, Workflows zu bauen und zu betreuen.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Enterprise-AI-Tools (z. B. Claude, ChatGPT) und Interesse daran, sie weiterzuentwickeln, einzuführen und zu governen. (Rechte- & Rollen-Modell, Permissions, Connector-Integration)
  • Erfahrung im Anbinden von Datenquellen für verschiedene AI Use Cases, Aufbereitung & Retrieval für (z. B. Embeddings, Vektor-Suche, Reranking).
  • Generelle technische Umsetzungsstärke (z. B. Python, APIs, Integrationen).
  • Bewusstsein für Datenschutz, Sicherheit und Governance (inkl. DSGVO).
  • Kenntnisse oder Interesse an agilen Methoden, Change-Management und Projektkoordination.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, motiviert, kommunikativ und teamübergreifend und begeisterst dich für neue AI-Technologien.

Das macht die Rolle besonders

In dieser Rolle bist du nah an den Menschen, die AI nutzen: Du machst aus konkreten Bedürfnissen funktionierende Lösungen – ob als Workflow in n8n, als Use-Case auf unserer Chat-Plattform oder als Anwendung auf unserer KI-Plattform. Du siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit im Unternehmen ankommt.

Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das sich schnell entwickelt und in dem viele AI-Themen gerade erst Form annehmen. Entsprechend breit ist das Themenfeld – von neuen Tools und Use-Cases über Automatisierung bis zu unserer entstehenden KI-Plattform. Wir suchen keine Spezialistin oder keinen Spezialisten für ein einzelnes Tool, sondern jemanden, der neue Technologien schnell versteht und in nachhaltige Lösungen übersetzt

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

In this pivotal role, you will work directly with a small, strategic set of software solution providers (and their developers) to champion the adoption of NVIDIA’s advanced AI and computing platforms. Your mission is to partner with software companies to build AI agent-powered tools and integrate AI into their products making use of the NVIDIA platform, including open models and software frameworks and libraries.

Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developers within the software companies you support, collaborating with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.

  • Engage partner technical leaders to drive best-practice integrations and resolve technical challenges, using regular syncs to track adoption, surface new workflows, and channel critical field insights back to NVIDIA product teams.

  • Represent NVIDIA at industry and developer events

  • Communicate the business and commercial value of integrating the NVIDIA platform into software company’s products

What We Need to See

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • A minimum of 8+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, product management, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in engaging with Product and Engineering organizations at enterprise-scale software companies on strategic product integrations.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Mozilla Firefox Performance team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest browser possible. We are the team responsible for making all parts of the browser go fast.

Our team is geographically-distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms - Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on finding and fixing things that slow down the browser as well as helping other teams write fast and reliable code to make Firefox excellent for users.

Do you value curiosity and enjoy finding a needle in a haystack? Do you approach problems by looking at the system as a whole? Do you want to help lead and shape the future of the Internet? Do you like making things blazingly fast? If so, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do:
  • Write code and tests, build prototypes, tackle problems, profile and analyze performance bottlenecks
  • Learn about a wide variety of problems and solutions across a large, complex, and evolving codebase
  • Use several programming languages (e.g., C++, JavaScript, Kotlin, Rust, Python) and techniques to fix performance issues, with an emphasis on C++ and JavaScript
  • Help to educate engineers on other teams about writing more performant code through code reviews, giving talks, implementing tooling, and/or writing documentation
  • Independently define and drive actionable next steps from high level objectives
  • Work with engineering teams across the organization to assist and lead performance efforts
  • Shape the future of performance benchmarks, and set the proper priorities for the necessary improvements
  • Develop strategies for the future of the Performance team and the Organization as a whole
  • Work with driven, committed team members to help bring the Open Web to millions of people
What you'll bring:
  • BS/MS in CS, CE and 7+ years relevant experience
  • A mastered understanding of programming in C++
  • An understanding of programming in JavaScript
  • You have proven experience developing performance critical software
  • You take an experimental and measured approach to solving problems (measurement, and using experiments to diagnose an issue or prove out a solution)
  • Proven skill in debugging and analyzing performance bottlenecks, and using profiling tools to diagnose and fix issues (VTune, Xperf, other sampling based profilers)
  • Experience with multithreading and concurrency, disk I/O, GPU
  • Proven track record of setting team goals and driving them to completion.
  • Experience motivating and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver on shared goals.
  • An interest and ability to work in a distributed team (which requires good asynchronous written communication skills as well as good verbal communication skills)
Bonus points if you have any of the following:
  • Familiarity with Web Standards or patterns
  • Familiarity with Android or Windows OS application programming
  • A solid understanding of statistics
  • Prior experience working on a modern web browser

We value a variety of voices on the Performance Team and at Mozilla. You don't need to check every box on this list to apply.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

jobs.excerpt: Canopy Connect is the leading insurance infrastructure provider.
jobs.description:
Canopy Connect is the leading insurance infrastructure provider. Our 1-click solution enables businesses to instantly and securely receive comprehensive insurance information from a consumer or business.

Companies use Canopy Connect to verify and track personal and commercial insurance. Fast. Directly from the source of truth. There are over a million businesses in the car rental, mobility, fleet, and gig economy industries that need to verify insurance. In addition, all delivery network companies and transportation network companies are now required by law to verify insurance on vehicles and operators.

Before we came along, there was no platform for exchanging verified insurance information.

For this reason, insurance verification was costly, time-consuming and error-prone. Consumers and operators had to go through many steps. Calling, faxing, emailing to verify information from the insurance carrier. It is an incredibly important step because it mitigates losses from vehicles and operators with inadequate insurance. It also bolsters identity verification and mitigates fraud.

Not properly verifying insurance is risky because it opens the business up to financial loss from vehicles and operators with inadequate insurance, legal issues and being held liable for accidents.

It also kill deals and causes friction in onboarding. Manual verification causes frustration & delays because it's tedious for consumers and businesses.

Companies buy the Canopy Connect platform so consumers and businesses can quickly and securely verify their insurance.

It’s now three easy steps:

1. Policyholder connects their insurance carrier. Select the insurance carrier and sign in.

2. The insurance data is shared from the insurance carrier in seconds via a secure API connection. This includes verified policy information, vehicle data, driver information, claims history, and PDFs of declarations pages.

3. The business can review and verify insurance policy details and coverage. Car rental companies also use this information to sell more Protection and Coverage products by showing how they provide additional protection on top of the current insurance policy.

Canopy Connect’s technology can pull more than 250 data fields from the insurance carrier—we are able to securely retrieve rich data from 96% of the US auto insurance market. And we do it fast—5.6 seconds on average. The speed at which Canopy Connect can share insurance information is critical, because people are busy and time kills conversion.

The result is faster converting onboarding and secure transactions that reduce the risk of inadequate insurance, fraud and compliance issues.

In this role, you'll build and scale our enterprise sales operations and partnerships with national and regional companies in the car rental, mobility, fleet, and gig economy industries. This role is remote, and you can be located anywhere in the US or Canada. The ideal candidate is an early-stage GTM expert with proven quota-carrying experience selling SaaS software to companies in these industries.

  • Proven quota-carrying experience selling SaaS software to companies in the car rental / mobility industry
  • Demonstrated ability to lead customers from discovery to close in highly complex sales that involve technical scoping, infosec, legal and regulatory compliance reviews.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to run a consultative sales process.
  • Proficiency with sales tools (e.g. CRM, Lead Management, Software).
  • Bonus: Deep industry knowledge in the car rental, mobility, fleet or gig economy industries.
  • Bonus: Programming experience in any language and experience with SQL databases.

Duties

  • Build pipeline through a combination of phone, email and social media outreach.
  • Convert prospects into customers through:
    • Thoughtful discovery conversations with prospects that feel more like consulting and less like sales.
    • Responsive, articulate communications, especially in written form
    • Hands on involvement with pilots to ensure conversion to production contracts
    • Creating and seeking approval from Canopy Connect management on pricing packages that meet prospect needs
  • Expand ARR with existing customers through:
    • Hands-on involvement with production project success
    • Deep understanding of customers needs and how Canopy Connect’s existing and upcoming products meet those needs
  • Prepare all materials and strategy for sales meetings that includes agendas, scripts, presentation materials and demos (as required).
  • Write thought leadership pieces or posts to elevate Canopy Connect’s brand.
  • Attend tradeshows to meet with prospects and industry partners.

Our Benefits

  • Healthcare: We offer company-sponsored health, dental and vision insurance for employees and dependents.
  • Equity: We are a team of owners and we provide our team with generous equity grants.
  • Time to Recharge: We offer unlimited paid time off. Unplug, recharge, and come back refreshed.

  • Friday Reimbursed Lunch: Order lunch on Fridays, and we'll cover it!
  • 401K: We offer a 3.5% match.

Our Core Values

  • Find a Way | We seize opportunities and iterate quickly. We refuse to get blocked. We are relentlessly optimistic about possibilities. Tenacious and creative, we find a way.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Alteva RCM, we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence.

About the Role

Alteva RCM is standing up a dedicated quality function for a high-impact operational technology team. This role is one of two founding QA hires, working alongside a Senior QA Engineer to build test coverage, automation, and process from the ground up.

This is a hybrid manual and automation QA role. You will be expected to manually validate features before release, execute regression testing, document results clearly, and help automate repeatable test cases as the QA function matures. A key goal of this role is to reduce the amount of testing currently being handled by managers and operations leads.

You'll be hands-on across a mix of Salesforce-native tools, AI-assisted workflows, and backend services, all actively in build. The work is a mix of manual testing, test case writing, automation development, and workflow documentation. You will help build a mature process from scratch

What You'll Do

  • Write and execute test for features across the internal product portfolio
  • Execute smoke, happy path, and regression testing based on release priorities and guidance from the Senior QA Engineer
  • Support and maintain automated test runs, including nightly checks where appropriate
  • Perform manual and automated testing in Salesforce sandbox environments and support production validation workflows
  • Contribute automation scripts and help maintain the automation framework established by the Senior QA Engineer
  • Support release readiness by executing regression plans and clearly documenting test results, defects, and remaining risks
  • Document business workflows and test coverage in clear, accessible formats
  • Work with operations team leads to understand how the business actually uses the tools you're testing
  • Clearly document test results, open defects, and release risks so product, development, and operations can make informed decisions
  • Investigate bugs and defects: reproduce, document, and track through to closure
  • Flag patterns when the same type of issue keeps appearing
  • Support regression testing cycles ahead of releases

What We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years in QA with experience in both manual and automated testing
  • Exposure to API testing, including REST and/or SOAP, is a plus
  • Basic SQL skills for data validation
  • Familiarity with version control such as Git
  • Salesforce experience required, with comfort in sandbox-based testing and production validation support
  • Hands-on experience writing automation scripts, with language and framework flexibility because the function is being built from scratch
  • Solid test case writing skills: clear, thorough, and reproducible
  • Comfortable working in .NET-adjacent environments
  • Good communicator, with the ability to work directly with developers, operations, and product
  • Detail-oriented and consistent: you catch things others miss and document them well
  • Background in healthcare RCM, medical billing, or complex operational workflows is a strong plus
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and change. This is a build environment where processes, systems, and structure are still being created

Why This Role

This is a ground-floor opportunity on a team that's growing fast. You'll have direct exposure to the full product lifecycle, work alongside experienced QA and product leadership, and build skills in AI tool testing, an area most QA engineers have not worked with yet. Alteva supports healthcare operations at scale. Quality work here has real business impact, not just internal metrics.

Tools & Environment

  • Salesforce, our core case management system
  • .NET-based services
  • Azure, in use for AI tooling
  • Jira for task tracking
  • Microsoft Teams

Location & Availability

This is a remote role requiring time zone overlap with two teams: our operations team in Israel and our development team in US Eastern time. You'll need a few hours of daily overlap with each. Eastern Europe time zones work well for this, though other locations will be considered if the overlap requirement is met.

Benefits

Alteva RCM offers our employees a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, employee assistance plan, paid family leave, short-term disability and life insurance. We also provide a 401(k) plan with employer match, flexible spending accounts, employee discount program and an employee referral program.

Role Title: Physics Expert (Postdoc / Junior professor)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US, Canada, UK focused)

micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (Postdoc / Junior professor) to participate in a high-impact project supporting a customer in the science and technology sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Critically evaluate and review physics solutions, mathematical derivations, and theoretical arguments generated by researchers or AI platforms.
  2. Detect errors, unjustified steps, missing assumptions, dimensional inconsistencies, and weaknesses in logic or methodology.
  3. Delineate between substantive scientific issues and stylistic or cosmetic matters, providing technically precise written feedback.
  4. Articulate and document the reasoning behind any identified flaws, ensuring actionable guidance for improvement.
  5. Recognize when correct reasoning can be optimized, and offer suggestions to sharpen or clarify the argument.
  6. Utilize LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter to independently verify or counter-check scientific claims as appropriate.
  7. Deliver structured feedback designed to support iterative enhancement of submitted work and project outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. PhD in physics and an active record of independent research within a specialized subfield (e.g., High Energy/Mathematical Physics, Biophysics/Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter, AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation/Cosmology, Quantum Information, or Optical Materials).
  2. Experience as a postdoctoral researcher, research fellow, junior/assistant professor, or senior research scientist.
  3. Recent (last ~5 years) representative publications in the relevant subfield, with arXiv or DOI links.
  4. Advanced proficiency with LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for theoretical modeling and computational validation.
  5. Demonstrated skill in reviewing the work of others—through peer review, supervision, dissertation committees, or group seminars.
  6. Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to convey nuanced, constructive feedback with technical rigor.
  7. Reliable access to high-speed internet and a computer suitable for rigorous technical work.
